He said #b#o47##k near #b#m10002000##k had it, so it sounded like I'd need to defeat them to get my hands on it.  \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 57 or higher can complete this quest.#k

0.0: Listen up. That #t4031132# you brought me — it wasn't made through any ordinary means. It's sealed with some pretty high-level magic, no doubt about it. Even I don't have what it takes to decipher this on my own.
0.1: But, if you could bring me a certain rare item... maybe, just maybe. So? Won't be easy... but you willing to give it a shot?

yes.0: Alright. Deep in the forest near #m10002000#, there's supposed to be a bunch of witches called #b#o47##k. One of them should be carrying something called #b#t4031133##k, so take them out and bring it back to me.

no.0: Heh heh... guess everything's gotten too troublesome for you now, huh?

1.0: Ohh... this is definitely #b#t4031133##k... didn't think you'd actually pull it off. Guess #p411# picked the right one this time, after all. Heheh...

item.0: Go defeat #b#o47##k deep in the forest near #m10002000# and bring me #b#t4031133##k. Without that, not even I can decipher this document.
